NewsArticle.Title: 40 New Clothing Variations
NewsArticle.Content:
40 new clothing variations appear in Client 2.25. These are regional variations of Circle 1 clothing, which is the clothing you are able to wear in each class at level 1.
The regional tailoring technique is the same as Circle 2 regional tailoring. A tailor and respected citizen can learn the art of regional tailoring. Go to one of the mundane tailors of the four regions: Mileth, Rucesion, Suomi, and Loures.
